_meta.description: Key milestones, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future.

events.title: MMRDA and DMRC sign DPR agreement
events.summary: MMRDA engages Delhi Metro Rail Corporation to prepare the Detailed Project Report for extending Metro Line 5 from Kalyan to Taloja.

events.title: MMRDA approves the project
events.summary: MMRDA's 146th Authority Meeting, held on 21 Nov 2018, approved the project.

events.title: Draft DPR submitted
events.summary: DMRC submits the draft DPR. MMRDA sends comments in February and March 2019.

events.title: Final DPR: 20.756 km, 17 stations, Rs 5,865 crore
events.summary: Final DPR proposes a fully elevated 20.756 km line with 17 stations from APMC Kalyan to Taloja and a depot near Pisarve.

events.title: State Government approval
events.summary: The Maharashtra Government approved the project by a Government Resolution dated 6 Sep 2019. Wikipedia gives 23 Jul 2019, which may be the Cabinet decision.

events.title: General Consultant bids invited (Lines 10 and 12)
events.summary: MMRDA invites bids for a joint General Consultant for Metro Lines 10 and 12.

events.title: SYSTRA MVA and DB Engineering JV appointed General Consultant
events.summary: Joint GC contract for Lines 10 and 12, bid Rs 265.10 crore, 54 months. The JV was named preferred bidder in July 2022.

events.title: First civil tender in two packages (CA-185, CA-186)
events.summary: Kalyan to Kolegaon and Kolegaon to Taloja, 17 stations. 11 firms submit 19 bids, opened 31 May 2023.

events.title: LKT Engineering and Enia Design JV named detailed design consultant
events.summary: Lowest bid Rs 6.51 crore against an MMRDA estimate of Rs 11.28 crore.

events.title: First civil tender cancelled for scope changes
events.summary: The two-package tender is cancelled. The new scope adds Kalyan and APMC Kalyan stations.

events.title: Civil works re-tendered as single package CA-240
events.summary: Viaduct and 19 stations, estimate Rs 1,877.88 crore, 30 months.

events.title: Gawar Constructions emerges lowest bidder for CA-240
events.summary: Bid Rs 2,037.20 crore. J Kumar Infraprojects second at Rs 2,158.62 crore.

events.title: Foundation stone laid
events.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde lays the foundation stone for Metro Line 12.

events.title: Civil contract CA-240 awarded to Gawar Constructions
events.summary: Letter of Award for Rs 1,971.77 crore after negotiation.

events.title: 100th U-girder launched
events.summary: Near Dombivli MIDC station on Shilphata Road.

events.title: 200th U-girder launched
events.summary: Near Golavali station on Kalyan-Shilphata Road. Exact date not stated in the source.

events.title: Metro Line 12A approved (related project)
events.summary: 18.4 km, 12 stations, Kalyan Phata to Taloja via Dahisar Mori, Rs 8,414.53 crore. Separate from Line 12.

events.title: Systems and rolling stock tender floated
events.summary: Trains, CBTC signalling, telecom, power supply, depot equipment, lifts and escalators, with maintenance. Estimate about Rs 4,882 crore.

events.title: Progress snapshot: piles 37%, U-girders 19%
events.summary: Pile works 37.12%, pile caps 31.54%, piers 25.88%, pier caps 26.84%, U-girder erection 18.75%.

events.title: Target completion (reported)
events.summary: The most recent reported target. The earlier reported target was 31 December 2027. MMRDA has not published a date.

events.title: Trial runs
events.summary: No date announced.
